The KubeVirt VM Management API extends the Kubernetes API with custom resources for running and managing virtual machines alongside containers. It provides CRD endpoints for VirtualMachine, VirtualMachineInstance, and VirtualMachineInstanceMigration resources, plus subresource REST endpoints for VM lifecycle operations including start, stop, pause, unpause, restart, migrate, and console/VNC access.
